tools.name: list_all_terms
tools.description: List every term of the Dictionary of Applied Machine Learning, one per line, as its display name followed by its key. Takes no arguments. Use it to find the key for a term before calling one of the tools that takes one.

tools.name: lookup_term
tools.description: The full dictionary entry for one term: its abstract, its definition, the works it cites and its cross-references. Use it when a specific term is already known; use search_terms when it is not.

tools.name: search_terms
tools.description: Search the term names, abstracts and definitions for a keyword or phrase and return the best matches, each with its abstract. Use it when the right term is not known in advance.

tools.name: get_related_terms
tools.description: The terms one entry cross-references, its See-also list, each with its abstract. Use it to widen a topic by one step from a term already in hand.

tools.name: list_learning_paths
tools.description: The author's curated reading orders through the dictionary: one per topic (how ChatGPT works, AI foundations, explainable and trustworthy AI, mathematics of AI, ...), each with its audience and its terms in the order to read them. Takes no arguments. Use when someone asks what to learn, read, or tea

tools.name: get_learning_path
tools.description: One reading order with the abstract of every term in it, in the order to read them. Give either `topic` or `terms`; giving neither returns the list of available reading orders.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_all_terms" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List every term of the Dictionary of Applied Machine Learning, one per line, as its display name followed by its key. Takes no arguments. Use it to find the key…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_all_terms" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
